scientific_integrity: Proof uses a finite-cycle matching bijection, parity-defect criterion, generating function and a primitivity argument. Finite exhaustive and random checkers corroborate but do not prove the infinite statement.
scientific_limitations: Proven for binary words of odd length 2k+1 with k>=1. No even-length or larger-alphabet count. Full 2021 related paper inaccessible; novelty assessment is based on specified accessible literature; external independent audit not performed.
title: Exact odd-length circular subsequence-universality necklaces and primitive extremizers
